name: Irvine Winter 2018

venue.name: Arnold O. Beckman High School Commons
venue.details: Enter through the front gate and make a left.

information: The competition will be held in the Anorld O. Beckman High School in the commons area. Due to the size of the venue, there will be a cap of  **100** competitors. The cost of registration is **$20** for every competitor. $1 of your registration fee will go to CubingUSA and $1 will go towards funding SoCal cubing expenses. **We will not be taking registration at the door.** Only the competitor has to pay for the competition. See the tabs for more details.
